**Finding submitted: T4C — missing (preferred-level cure).**

- **What the document does:** Article IV commits Licensee to a 36-month Initial Period (p0049). The only termination rights in the Agreement are Licensor's immediate termination for Licensee breach (p0043, p0049), mutual insolvency termination (p0132), automatic termination on Change of Control and Licensor termination on Licensee wind-up (p0134, p0137), plus effect-of-termination mechanics (p0138). No convenience exit exists for either party, and no early-termination fee or refund mechanic exists.
- **Why flagged:** No Customer convenience right in a multi-year term is walk-away territory under T4C. Licensor's seven-year renewal option is a renewal matter, not a mid-term Vendor convenience right, so it is not double-flagged.
- **Cure:** One inserted paragraph after p0049 giving Licensee convenience termination on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and expressly denying Licensor any convenience termination during the Initial Period or any extension — covering all four preferred elements with no added boilerplate (no "in whole or in part", as there is no Order Form structure here).
